category_edits.rationale: Test a smaller attenuation from 0.02 to 0.018 across all four datasets, avoiding the previously evaluated 0.01 configuration. Retain training-only standardized log-count features, unit padding/mask scales, and checkpointed input scales. Preserve embeddings, backbone, readout, loss, optimizer and routing.

change_summary: Reduce training-frequency input modulation from 0.02 to 0.018 for each category’s single BERT4Rec model. Existing checkpoint and predictor plumbing preserves consistency.
